text:
arjun: hi team, first day! trying to get the dev cluster. i downloaded the kubeconfig from the access portal and ran `kubectl config get-contexts` — i see contexts: redwood-dev, redwood-staging, redwood-prod. when i `kubectl get ns` i get an error: "Error from server (Forbidden): namespaces is forbidden: User "arjun@redwood" cannot list resource "namespaces"". who owns namespace access for new hires?

liz: welcome 🎉. hey @ivan or @sre-lead can you advise? arjun, did you follow the onboarding step to request namespace bindings via the portal?

arjun: i filed the portal request (ticket ONB-492) but wanted to try local checks. also worried about accidentally using prod — is there a safe way to limit contexts?

ivan: good call. two quick things: 1) use `kubectl config use-context redwood-dev` before running commands, 2) we scope RBAC per-team. if the portal request is pending we can give temporary `view` role in `team-arjun` namespace.

arjun: how do i check which user the kubeconfig is using?

liz: `kubectl config view --minify -o jsonpath='{.users[0].name}'` shows the active user. Also `kubectl config current-context` then `kubectl config view -o jsonpath='{.contexts[?(@.name=="'$(kubectl config current-context)'")].context.user}'` if you have multiple entries.

arjun: running `kubectl config view --minify -o jsonpath='{.users[0].name}'` -> `arjun@redwood`

onboarding-bot: Reminder: onboarding checklist item 3 (Kubernetes access) — please attach the portal ticket number to expedite RBAC. Docs: https://docs.internal/redwood/onboarding/k8s-access

sre-lead: @ivan i see ONB-492 in the queue. i can grant a namespace-scoped rolebinding `view` to `arjun@redwood` for 72 hours. arjun — can you test with `kubectl auth can-i get pods -n team-arjun` after i apply?

arjun: sure.

sre-lead: done: created RoleBinding `rb-onboard-arjun` in `team-arjun` binding ClusterRole `view` to user `arjun@redwood`, expires in 72h.

arjun: `kubectl auth can-i get pods -n team-arjun` -> yes. `kubectl get pods -n team-arjun` shows three pods. thanks! :raised_hands:

ivan: re: avoiding prod mistakes: we encourage keeping per-cluster kubeconfigs separate under `~/.kube/context-files/` and setting `KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/context-files/dev.yaml` while you work, instead of merging. small tip: `kubectx` + `kubens` are installed in the dev image.

arjun: what's the process to extend beyond 72h?

liz: reopen the portal ticket and request extension with justification (ticket id + PR link if relevant). security will review; if it's for ongoing work we'll move you to a team rolebinding instead of temp access.

arjun: perfect. last Q: i saw a `service-account` in the docs — when would we use that vs user bindings?

sre-lead: service accounts are for automation (CI, tools). for humans we use identity-bound bindings (SSO users). if you need a token for a tool we can create a namespaced SA and mount the token into the pod.

arjun: all clear. thanks for the quick help — closing this thread.
